source: Dry Bean Dataset, Koklu & Ozkan 2020, UCI ML Repository, https://doi.org/10.24432/C50S4B
method: z-score 16 features; project on top-3 PCs; drop within-class Mahalanobis outliers above q0.98; stratified subset 340/class (seed 7223); scale 99th-pct radius to 1; rotate Euler XYZ [-62.0, 18.0, 25.0] deg; principal_directions/singular_values from SVD of the exported centred points
